metaTitle: Digital Marketing Agency in Burlington, VT | TDM
metaDescription: Digital marketing for Burlington businesses: SEO, paid ads, social media, websites and video for shops, restaurants, brands and services around Lake Champlain.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Burlington businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Burlington is Vermont's largest city, though small by national standards: a lakefront college town with a strong independent streak and several consumer brands known far beyond the state. We plan marketing that fits a market of this size and reaches the students, residents, visitors and online buyers who keep it going.

sections.heading: A college town on the lake
paragraphs: The University of Vermont sits on the hill above downtown, with Champlain College nearby, and the university's medical centre is the main hospital for the region and one of the area's largest employers. Students and staff shape the city's rhythm: a surge at the start of the academic year, parents in town for family weekends and graduation, and a noticeably quieter stretch when the students leave.

Summer belongs to the lake. The waterfront park, the bike path, the marina and the ferry bring residents and tourists down to the shore, and downtown restaurants and shops are at their busiest. Winter brings skiers on their way to the mountains east of the city. Visitors come from across New England and New York, and Montreal is close enough for a weekend trip.

sections.heading: Church Street, the South End and the towns next door
paragraphs: Church Street Marketplace, a pedestrian street in the centre, is the best-known shopping and dining address in the state. The South End, along Pine Street, is the creative and industrial quarter, with breweries, studios, makers and offices in former factory buildings, and it hosts a large art event each September.

Burlington is only part of the local market. South Burlington has the airport and major retail, Williston has the big-box stores, Winooski is a small former mill city with a lively restaurant scene, and Essex, Colchester and Shelburne complete the ring. People move between them freely, and a business that mentions only Burlington will miss searches from next door.
bullets: Pages and profile details that name the neighbouring towns you serve.
Campaigns timed to the university calendar and the summer lake season.
Photography and short video shot in recognisable local places.
Ads kept to a sensible radius, with nearby visitor markets added for hospitality.

sections.heading: Brands that sell far beyond Chittenden County
paragraphs: For a small city, Burlington has an unusual number of well-known consumer names. Ben & Jerry's started here, Burton has its headquarters in the city, and chocolate, cleaning product, outdoor and craft beer brands have grown up in and around the South End.

Many smaller makers follow the same path, selling to the rest of the country from a Vermont address. For them the local market is a testing ground and the online store is the business. We work on stores that are easy to buy from, product shoots, creator-style video, search visibility and paid campaigns measured against margin.

sections.heading: A market that rewards the genuine
paragraphs: Burlington shoppers are loyal to independent, locally owned businesses and care about how products are made. Claims about sourcing or sustainability should be specific and true, because customers here check.

presence: TDM works with Burlington businesses remotely. We do not have an office or team member in the city. Work on strategy, design, development and video happens online, and we report to you in writing and on video calls.

faqs.q: Does TDM have an office in Burlington?
faqs.a: No. We work with Burlington businesses remotely, with video calls, shared documents and regular reports.

faqs.q: Is digital marketing worth it in a city as small as Burlington?
faqs.a: Yes, if it is scaled correctly. A local service needs an accurate business profile, reviews, a fast site and modest, well-aimed ads. A shop or brand with wider appeal can use an online store and paid campaigns to reach visitors and buyers outside Vermont.

faqs.q: When is the busiest time for Burlington businesses?
faqs.a: It varies by trade. Lakefront and downtown hospitality peak in summer and during autumn foliage. Businesses serving students are busiest around move-in and graduation. We look at your own sales to set the calendar.

faqs.q: How much does a marketing agency cost in Burlington, VT?
faqs.a: What you pay depends on the scope. We learn about your goals in a free consultation and then send a quote.

faqs.q: How soon can a Burlington business expect results?
faqs.a: That comes down to your requirements and the brief. The timeline is agreed with you in the plan before work begins.
